home.metaDescription: 8th edition of the SENICO Grand Prix for Quran recitation. Registration, categories, calendar and prizes.

hero.title: SENICO Quran Recitation Contest 2026 Edition
hero.lead: This contest brings together reciters of the Holy Quran. SENICO is the annual gathering dedicated to excellence in recitation and memorization.

about.title: Promoting excellence in the recitation of the Holy Quran
about.text: Launched by the Ministry of National Education under the direct guidance of the President of the Republic, the SENICO International Prize celebrates learning, memorization and the refinement of Quran recitation, establishing Senegal as a spiritual hub of wide reach.

tilawa.title: Tilawa
tilawa.label: Melodic recitation
tilawa.text: Highlighting vocal beauty, harmonic modulation and a spiritual rhythm in keeping with prophetic traditions.

tafsir.title: Tafsir
tafsir.label: Interpretation
tafsir.text: A thorough understanding of the verses, the contexts of revelation (Asbab an-Nuzul) and exegesis.

tajwid.title: Tajwid
tajwid.label: Recitation rules
tajwid.text: Precise mastery of elocution, the points of articulation (Makharij) and the phonetic features of expression.

c1.title: Nationality & residence
c1.text: Senegalese nationality, or legal residence in Senegal at the time of final registration.

c2.title: Required age
c2.text: Be between 7 and 45 years of age on the application closing date.

c3.title: Recitation level
c3.text: Master at least 5 juz' for the youth category, and complete Hifz for the adult category.

c4.title: Participation rules
c4.text: Must not have already won first prize in a previous SENICO edition.

d4.title: Regional stage
d4.text: Events in Dakar, Thiès and Ziguinchor

d5.title: National grand final
d5.text: Ceremony in the presence of the Head of State

n1.title: Registration is now open for the 2026 edition

n2.title: Winners will receive scholarships and distinctions

n3.title: Opening ceremony chaired by the Head of State
